X-FILES BABX12 "UNTITLED" (GOLD) 11/29/00 28 (X).
23 CONTINUED: a3
Burks seems somewhat tentative, after Scully's build-up.
CHUCK BURKS
I'm a... little embarrassed to — (X)
admit... I'm not sure what the
heck's going on here...
| Doggett takes this in. Scully indicates the video tape.
SCULLY
But these men, these ascetic
masters, they have abilities...
CHUCK BURKS
Yes. Abilities similar to those
you told me about on the phone
have been ascribed to what are
known as siddhi mystics.
DOGGETT
That's them in the picture?
CHUCK BURKS
No. They're a very mysterious
and particularly powerful order
of fakir. The siddhi pass on
their secret practices from
father to son, gaining occult
powers with each generation.
DOGGETT |
What do you mean, “powers?"
CHUCK BURKS (X)
Powers of the mind, used to make (X)
themselves invisible or tiny as (X)
: an atom. Manipulating reality. (X)
DOGGETT (X)
You'd hope they were tiny, where (X)
whoever this is has been going. (X)
Doggett smiles, looking to Scully. Hoping she can appreciate how
preposterous it all sounds. But Scully tries to move past it.
| SCULLY
Could a siddhi mystic make you (X)
think he’s vanished from a room,
| when in fact he's standing right
in front of you?
| CONTINUED
Page 35
X-FILES BABX12 "UNTITLED" (YELLOW) 11/29/00 29 (X)
._ 23 CONTINUED: (2) | 23
| CHUCK BURKS
Totally. Or disguise themselves.
Appearing as virtually anyone.
Doggett's heard enough.
| DOGGETT
I'm sorry, Dr. Burks, you're a
professor of what? --
CHUCK BURKS
I run the Advanced Digital
Imaging Lab at the University of
| Maryland. And I dabble.
DOGGETT
(nods)
| You dabble.
Chuck shrugs. Doggett looks to Scully.
DOGGETT
Well, it's been... insightful.
| Doggett exits, with little more than a nod. Chuck SHRUGS again.
| Scully seems more perturbed by her new partner than he does.
| CHUCK BURKS |
It doesn't surprise me. (X)
SCULLY (X)
What? _ (X)
